package.name: f1tenth_gateway
package.description: Gateway for the F1Tenth Lab Control PWA: REST and one WebSocket for the phone, manual driving on the ackermann_mux /teleop lane with a 250 ms watchdog, the e-stop on a node kept ready from start-up, missions planned and started through f1tenth_ctl, the run archive. Runs on the car outside the stack, as a systemd user unit behind tailscale serve. FastAPI and uvicorn come from a venv (README), not from rosdep.
